title: Database Migration — PostgreSQL 13 to PostgreSQL 16
description:
Migrate production database from PostgreSQL 13.12 to PostgreSQL 16.1. Key improvements: native table partitioning (required for events table at 180M rows), improved query planner, logical replication enhancements.

Approvals: Raj Patel (email_06, Oct 23), Priya Sharma (email_07, Oct 24), Legal (data residency confirmed separately).

Maintenance window: November 3, 02:00 - 06:00 IST.

Result: Completed successfully in 3h 43m (email_11). Events table partitioned by month, 40% query performance improvement. Known follow-up: NEX-244 (missing index issue).

See docs/database-migration-plan.md for full runbook.
